ارتقبن (form VIII)
# اِرْتَقَبْنَ (irtaqabna) /ir.ta.qab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# اُرْتُقِبْنَ (urtuqibna) /ur.tu.qib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# اِرْتَقِبْنَ (irtaqibna) /ir.ta.qib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
